name: Frame Energy
mechanism:
This method analyzes total frame energy for video forensic detection:

1. **FrameEnergy계산**: Total frame energy is computed as E = Σ I(x,y)² over all pixels, along with AC energy (energy excluding DC component, measuring content energy). Per-region energy (face, background, edges, smooth areas) provides a spatial energy map.

2. **시간적Energy프로파일**: Frame energy is tracked across time. Natural video shows smooth energy evolution with changes correlated to content (brighter scenes = higher energy, more texture = higher AC energy). Deepfakes may produce energy profiles with anomalous micro-fluctuations from frame-independent generation.

3. **채널Energy분포**: Energy distribution across color channels (R, G, B) should be consistent with scene illumination. The method measures per-channel energy ratios. Deepfake face insertion may alter channel energy distribution in the face region relative to the background.

4. **주파수-BandEnergyPartition**: Frame energy is decomposed into frequency bands (low, medium, high frequency). Natural images partition energy predictably with approximately 1/f spectral character. AI-generated content may show anomalous energy in specific frequency bands — excess energy at the generator's characteristic frequencies or insufficient high-frequency energy.

5. **Energy일관성점수 산출**: The temporal stability of energy, spatial coherence of energy distribution, and conformity to natural image energy statistics are combined into a forensic score. Systematic energy anomalies — particularly between face regions and surrounding content — indicate manipulation.
parameters:
분석 유형: 통계
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through frame energy analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
